papers.title: Deletion, arrows, windows and composition: structural patterns in 10,404 certified polytope packings
papers.summary: Classifies eleven structural patterns across the 10,404-record catalogue in dimensions three to six. It distinguishes Lean-verified construction mechanisms, empirical descriptive patterns and extremal results, then studies their relationships, higher-dimensional rotations and contributor constructions.
papers.review_status: Author manuscript / preprint; journal acceptance or independent external peer review is not documented
papers.version_note: Author-provided version dated 8 November 2026, 21 pages. The older repository PDF and its accompanying source remain separately available.

papers.title: Certified architecture transfer from polyhedral packing catalogues to finite-cluster magnetic response
papers.summary: A computational materials benchmark transfers a credited 28-cube packing into an uncalibrated finite-cluster equilibrium magnetic model. Controlled architecture, orientation and compression comparisons distinguish packing density from the modelled response. The study separates exact geometry, numerical validation and physical assumptions.
papers.license: CC BY 4.0 for the manuscript, author-created figures, tables and study data. Software and third-party components retain their accompanying license notices.
papers.review_status: Accepted and published at JOATP; editorially reviewed article. AI-assisted editorial assessment and final verification; publication decision by Todd J. Desiato. The article explicitly claims no independent external referee review.
papers.venue: Journal of Alternative Theoretical Physics (JOATP), Volume 1, Issue 1
papers.record_lineage: The source layout is credited to Hirotaka Nakano (konoha-ily2); PingYou Ltd supplied the recorded padding refinement. The author contributed the catalogue framework and architecture-transfer study.
papers.version_note: The DOI identifies the original v1.0 data, code and proof supplement. It is not a DOI for the accepted v1.1 manuscript.

papers.title: Shape Continuation for Convex-Polytope Packing: Generalization and Lean-Verified Catalogue Certificates
papers.summary: Generalizes soft-to-rigid search and certification to convex polyhedra and higher-dimensional polytopes. A dimension-independent Lean soundness development supports 402 rational and 130 additional algebraic-coordinate witnesses across all 140 frozen problem families, with explicit scope boundaries.
papers.review_status: Repository manuscript / preprint; no journal acceptance is established by the inspected public repository copy

papers.title: Certified finite packings of Platonic solids: a generalized soft-to-rigid search and its computational development
papers.summary: The initial account of the generalized soft-to-rigid implementation and its computational development for Platonic-solid packing. This original deposited stage must be distinguished from the later expanded catalogue and Lean supplement.
papers.review_status: Deposited preprint; independent peer review is not established by the DOI record
